exposure: Retrospective public-paper reanalysis. Qualitative batch findings, calibration figure and article text read before freeze. Source article XML retained before freeze contains qualitative target information. Figure 1 numerical target annotations not read before freeze; it is acquired afterwards. No external preregistration, global blinding, raw-cell likelihood, or new measurements.
parameter_meaning: Arithmetic mean and variance of the source lognormal fits, not log-space parameters and not necessarily empirical sample moments
primary_comparison: birth_population versus birth_lineage; improvement requires smaller error on both endpoints in each medium; no pooled winner or significance test
score: Absolute natural logarithm of predicted / published fitted endpoint, reported separately per medium and endpoint
